verdict.rationale: Spline ships a built-in AI Agent that autonomously builds and edits 3D scenes ('describe what you want and it does the work through the editor itself — creating objects, setting up materials and lighting, animating, wiring interactivity') and a parallel Hana AI Agent for 2D screens, both directly matching the delegated-task story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the agent's real-world reliability and scope beyond first-party docs.
